title: Get the members of a Twitter/X List by its numeric List ID. Returns up to 100 us
description: Get the members of a Twitter/X List by its numeric List ID. Returns up to 100 user profiles per page with pagination support. Query params: id (string, required) - numeric List ID; next_token (string, optional) - pagination cursor, e.g. GET /lists/members?id=84839422. Returns X v2 API-compatible JSON.

_signals.x_guidance: This API requires MPP payment via Tempo for each request. Costs range from $0.0025 to $0.01 USDC per call. To use: (1) send a probe request to get a 402 challenge, (2) pay via Tempo using an MPP client such as mppx, (3) retry with the payment credential in the Authorization header. No gas required — server sponsors all Tempo gas fees.
